visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a piece of cooked pork belly and pickled melon held by wooden chopsticks. The meat is succulent with a brownish glaze, and steam rises slightly in the bright studio lighting. (2) Hands wearing white plastic gloves are shown marinating raw, sliced pork belly in a clear glass bowl on a light wooden surface. Soy sauce is poured from a bottle, followed by sugar being sprinkled in. (3) The gloved hands add stock from a green and white can into the bowl, then add white cornstarch. The hands vigorously mix the meat to ensure it is evenly coated. (4) Marinated meat is poured from the glass bowl into a hot black frying pan using a red and black silicone spatula. The meat begins to sear on the dark surface. (5) Minced garlic, slices of pale pickled melon, bamboo shoots, and cut green onion stalks are added to the pan with the meat. The camera uses a medium close-up to show the sizzling ingredients. (6) Fermented bean paste, additional sugar, white pepper, and more stock are added to the pan. The chef uses the spatula to toss the ingredients, creating a vibrant stir-fry visual. (7) Sliced red chilies and more chopped green onions are added for color, followed by a splash of rice wine. The ingredients are tossed once more in the pan as the liquid bubbles. (8) The finished dish is plated onto a white plate with brown concentric circles. The camera zooms in on the final presentation, showing the glistening textures of the pork and vegetables.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 越瓜脯炒肉片. [Logo]: wecook123. (2) [Slogan]: 三層肉 250g, 醬油 1大匙, 砂糖 1小匙. (3) [Subtitle]: 加入適量高湯進行打水動作. (4) [Subtitle]: 加入太白粉抓醃. (5) [Subtitle]: 炒肉片. (6) [Slogan]: 蒜頭 3粒, 醃漬越瓜 150g, 涼筍 1根, 青蔥 2根. (7) [Slogan]: 米豆醬 1大匙, 砂糖 1大匙, 白胡椒 適量, 高湯 350c.c.. (8) [Subtitle]: 加入辣椒和蔥花做點綴. (9) [Subtitle]: 加入適量米酒.
